history.text: The region was heavily depopulated by trans-Saharan and Atlantic slave raiding.
France established the territory of Ubangi-Shari.
Jean-Bedel Bokassa ruled, declaring an empire in 1976.
Conflict between Seleka and anti-balaka groups displaced much of the population.

worthSeeing.title: Boali Falls:

worthSeeing.title: Manovo-Gounda St Floris:
worthSeeing.text: A northern savannah park, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
